scope: Conservative project guidance, not an additional policy or calibrated model.

patterns.name: CARD_NOT_PRESENT_FRAUD
patterns.description: Customer-reported unrecognized online transaction; a supported working hypothesis, not independently confirmed fraud.

patterns.name: UNRECOGNIZED_CARD_TRANSACTION
patterns.description: Customer reports not making the flagged transaction; the mechanism is unknown.

patterns.name: CARD_TESTING
patterns.description: R5 requires the actual ordered timed sequence. Aggregate small/online counts do not establish this pattern; clearing status requires separate evidence.

patterns.name: UNKNOWN
patterns.description: Use when no documented pattern has all required supporting evidence. Historical patterns alone do not classify the current transaction.
